scope: Semgrep 1.183.0 CLI-only transitive dependencies; these are recorded exposure assessments, not vendor patches or a clean dependency audit.

exceptions.reason: The MCP SDK is pinned by Semgrep. RepoSentinel starts only semgrep scan; it does not instantiate or expose an MCP Streamable HTTP server. No MCP sessions are accepted.
RepoSentinel does not instantiate an MCP HTTP/SSE client or OAuth provider. Model requests use its own httpx client with redirects disabled.
There is no MCP bearer-authenticated server. RepoSentinel uses its own constant-time comparison of a single-owner token; it does not use MCP AuthSettings or a shared OAuth issuer.
No MCP ClientSession or tool result validation occurs in RepoSentinel. Semgrep is invoked only with trusted local scan rules; no MCP servers are contacted.

Semgrep pins the OpenTelemetry family. The API has no OpenTelemetry middleware or inbound trace-header extraction, uses uvicorn h11, and scanner subprocesses disable OTEL SDK/propagators. Reassess immediately if tracing is enabled.
